versions.changelog:
xhs-publisher v1.0.0

- Initial release of xhs-publisher skill for 小红书网页端笔记发布与管理。
- Supports long text, image-text, and video note publishing, scheduled publishing, draft management, comment reply, and data analysis.
- Includes process guides for each function/scenario and best practices for network and content compliance.
- Local backup/record functions for drafts, scheduled queue, and replied comments.
- Provides detailed comment reply templates and interactive strategies.
- Emphasizes importance of AI/content declaration and safe network environment.
